summary: REQ-1 and REQ-2 appear implemented via BottomNav and GroupsPage updates, and routes for /pages and /pages/create were added in App.tsx with new page components. However, the diff summary does not show the required static icon asset file being added, and the Create Page form UI details are truncated so not all required fields/options can be verified from the provided evidence.

missing_requirements.requirement: Add a new static icon asset for the bottom navigation "Pages" item under frontend/public/assets/generated and reference it in bottom navigation.
missing_requirements.reason: BottomNav references /assets/generated/pages-icon.dim_32x32.png, but the diff summary does not show any new file added under frontend/public/assets/generated (only TSX files were added).
evidence: File diff summary ADDED FILES list (no frontend/public/assets/generated/* shown)

missing_requirements.requirement: Create Page screen must include a form with fields: Page Name (required), Category (Politics/News/Business/Community/Public Figure), Description, Profile Image upload, Cover Image upload, Visibility (Public/Private), Verification request toggle.
missing_requirements.reason: CreatePagePage.tsx is truncated; while state variables and handlers suggest these fields exist, the rendered form controls (including the exact Category options and the presence of all specified fields) are not visible in the provided diff summary, so full implementation cannot be verified from the evidence.

hallucinated_features.description: Require user to be logged in to submit the Create Page form (identity check with error toast).
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest did not specify authentication as a requirement for accessing/submitting the Create Page form; it only required client-side validation for Page Name and a non-persisted submission message.

hallucinated_features.description: Auto-navigate back to /pages after submission using a 2-second timeout.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest only required showing an English toast/notification indicating the creation flow is not persisted; it did not request automatic navigation after submit.

hallucinated_features.description: Introduce/modify project_state.json to describe a much broader Pages module scope including backend/data structures, roles/permissions, moderation, and analytics.
hallucinated_features.reason: Non-goals explicitly exclude implementing full Pages backend storage, roles/permissions, moderation, analytics, and backend changes; updating state to describe these broader items was not requested as part of the build requirements.
